scientific_question: On the frozen 131-construct MAGE development set, can a predictor using only external-RCS-derived features replace the intrinsic baseline, and how do the existing intrinsic+RCS and full-mechanism arms compare with that pure external predictor?

development_data.development_reuse_disclosure: All labels, folds and existing-arm predictions come from the already-used train+dev nested-CV artifact. This is a development-only comparator, not independent confirmation and not authorization to evaluate the frozen 33-construct test partition.

pure_external_arm.name: pure_external_rcs
pure_external_arm.feature_source: RCS of the variant and wild-type control from the external supervised structure feature already frozen in features_json; delta and absolute delta are deterministic external-only transforms
pure_external_arm.scope: This closes the ambiguity of the old rcs_only name, which contained intrinsic features. It is a pure external-RCS predictor, not a claim to replace every possible external pretrained model.

frozen_existing_arms.intrinsic: reuse frozen OOF predictions; categorical baseline plus intrinsic numeric features
frozen_existing_arms.rcs_only: reuse frozen OOF predictions; intrinsic plus RCS additions, retained under its historical arm name
frozen_existing_arms.full_mechanism: reuse frozen OOF predictions; intrinsic plus local-MFE and RCS additions

nested_cv.outer_fold_source: frozen OOF CSV; independently verify against SHA256(seed + ':' + construct_id) round-robin assignment
nested_cv.inner_assignment: SHA256(seed + ':inner:' + construct_id) round-robin within each outer-training partition, identical to the frozen protocol
nested_cv.alpha_selection: minimum inner out-of-fold RMSE; ties resolved by larger alpha then lexicographic alpha string
nested_cv.outer_prediction: refit on the complete outer-training partition with selected alpha and predict the held-out outer fold

inference.bootstrap_ci: two-sided 95% percentile over construct resampling with replacement
inference.permutation_scheme: independently swap candidate/reference prediction pairs within each construct; two-sided absolute-effect plus-one p value
inference.multiplicity: Holm across six tests: three comparisons times two metrics
inference.sensitivity: point estimates for all three comparisons on both sensitivity seeds; favorable support requires delta Spearman > 0 and delta RMSE < 0 in both repetitions
comparison_support_requires_all: primary delta Spearman CI lower bound > 0
primary delta RMSE CI upper bound < 0
both sensitivity repetitions have the pre-specified favorable signs

gate_and_interpretation.positive_comparator_result_scope: A supported pure-external or augmentation contrast is limited to this reused development protocol. It does not erase the prior no-go, prove causal mechanism, establish protein OOD, or authorize test, transport, generation or a SOTA claim.

technical_contract.report_overall_pass_scope: technical and reproducibility contract only; never a scientific GO
